newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pao de Acucar started.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel analyst Luiz Ernesto Godinho said on Tuesday he had started coverage of Brazilian food retailer Grupo Pao de Acucar with a rating of buy.
-- "Pao de Acucar is a substantial and highly efficient retailer trading at a relatively cheap valuation," Godinho wrote in an analysis.
-- "Earnings growth will be slowed by tax charges in '97 and '98, but should remain above the sector average; operating earnings growth remains very high.
-- "The company is improving its stores at a rapid rate and there is the possibility of cheap acquisitions as smaller retailers suffer in a more competitive environment.
-- "Pao de cocucar also presents a lower credit default risk than its competitors."
